en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
I said to Abu Ibrahim (Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as)): A man directs another man to a commodity and says, 'Buy it, and half of it will be mine.' The man buys it and pays from his own money.
The Imam (as) replied: "He is entitled to half the profit."

I asked: "What if there is a loss; does he also bear part of the loss?"
The Imam (as) said: "Yes, he is liable for the loss just as he shares in the profit."
